issues.text: E2K-50 of tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js stays the only red test, with the same message 'test/e2e/kit/stand.js: reads TEMP' and the same cause as in step 02 (issue I1 there): the six base-list names are not yet in ENV_NAMES. This rework does not touch it; TEST-DESIGNER fixes it at sub-step 3 (design section 12 row 1).

For TEST-DESIGNER (step 5, inside E2S-11 as the task says; no test was written here): the mode quit-later prints the link and exits 0 by itself 300 ms later. A test must first wait for the fact isRunning() false (limit 5 s), then expect stop() to reject with STAND_EXIT whose message is 'fake ended with exit code 0 on its own. Last line of its stderr: ""', and no term in the log. A stop() called before the 300 ms sends SIGTERM and resolves { code: 0, signal: null } (shown by the proof), so the wait is needed.

A residual of the reading, not a change: a stand that ends by itself in the very moment stop() is called, before the starter has seen its exit, still gets the SIGTERM and is read as a stop after SIGTERM; with code 0 stop() then resolves. From outside the two cannot be told apart (a leader that has ended but is not yet reaped still takes the signal). A test meets it only if it calls stop() in that moment; E2S-11 waits for isRunning() false first.
